settings.locked: HUD editing is switched off on this server
settings.title: HUD, food and drink
settings.description: Controls how fast hunger and thirst drop, what every food and drink does, buffs, poison, horse food and satchels. w_hud's own panel (F7) stays as it is.

hudmenu.label: Open w_hud's own panel
hudmenu.help: Closes the admin panel and opens w_hud's own panel (F7) for you. It has the same server settings plus each player's HUD look.

needs.label: Hunger and thirst speed
needs.help: Sets how much and how often hunger and thirst drop for every player. A change reaches everyone from the next cycle, no restart.

hungerRate.label: Hunger drop per cycle
hungerRate.help: Takes this many points off the hunger bar (out of 100) every cycle. Higher = players get hungry faster; 0 = never hungry.
hungerRate.example: 1 every 90 s = full to empty in about 2.5 hours

thirstRate.label: Thirst drop per cycle
thirstRate.help: Takes this many points off the thirst bar every cycle. Same idea as hunger; keep it a little higher since drinking is easier than eating.
thirstRate.example: 1.4 every 90 s = parched in about 1 h 47 min

interval.label: Cycle length
interval.help: Sets how many seconds pass between two drops. Smaller = a faster, smoother drain. The floor is 5 s so the server is not overloaded.
interval.example: 90 = once every minute and a half

damage.label: Starvation damage
damage.help: Decides what happens when a player is very hungry or thirsty: their health drops little by little, and they can die if you allow it.

enabled.label: Hunger and thirst hurt health
enabled.help: Makes a player's health drop once hunger or thirst falls under the limit. Off: hunger is only a number on screen.

hungerAt.label: Damage starts when hunger is under
hungerAt.help: Health starts dropping once hunger is under this number (out of 100). Higher = damage starts earlier.
hungerAt.example: 15 = when less than 15 hunger is left

thirstAt.label: Damage starts when thirst is under
thirstAt.help: Health starts dropping once thirst is under this number (out of 100). Higher = damage starts earlier.
thirstAt.example: 15 = when less than 15 thirst is left

amount.label: Health lost per hit
amount.help: Takes this percent of the health bar on every starvation hit.
amount.example: 2 = two percent of health per hit

interval.label: Seconds between hits
interval.help: Sets the time between two starvation hits. Smaller = starvation kills faster.
interval.example: 2% every 20 s = about 17 minutes from the first hit to death

canKill.label: Starvation can kill
canKill.help: On: a starving or parched player can die. Off: their health stops just before death.

features.label: HUD elements shown
features.help: Turns parts of the HUD on or off on every player's screen at once. A player cannot bring back a part you turned off.

health.label: Health circle
health.help: Shows the health circle on every player's HUD. Off: it disappears from their screens at once; health itself is not affected.

stamina.label: Stamina circle
stamina.help: Shows the stamina circle on every player's HUD. Off: only the circle goes; stamina works as usual.

hunger.label: Hunger circle
hunger.help: Shows the hunger circle to everyone. Hiding it does not stop hunger: players still get hungry, they just cannot see how much is left.

thirst.label: Thirst circle
thirst.help: Shows the thirst circle to everyone. Hiding it does not stop thirst: players still get thirsty, they just cannot see how much is left.

voice.label: Voice level
voice.help: Shows the player's voice level (whisper, normal, loud, shouting) on the HUD.

horse.label: Horse health and stamina
horse.help: Shows the horse's health and stamina circles while riding.

buffs.label: Buff icons
buffs.help: Shows the buffs running on the player and how much of each is left.

ammo.label: Ammo
ammo.help: Shows how many rounds the weapon in hand has.

money.label: Money
money.help: Shows cash and gold on the HUD.

identity.label: Server name or logo
identity.help: Shows the server's name or logo in the screen corner for everyone.

compass.label: Compass
compass.help: Shows the compass and heading at the top of the screen.

location.label: Location name
location.help: Shows the name of the area or town the player is in.

playerImages.label: Player pictures
playerImages.help: Lets players put a picture in their HUD elements. Off: their pictures disappear.

playerPanel.label: Players edit their HUD
playerPanel.help: Lets players open the HUD panel (F7) and move or recolour their HUD. Off: everyone keeps the default look.

identity.label: Server name and logo on the HUD
identity.help: Changes the name or logo every player sees in the screen corner. Its exact place is easiest to drag in w_hud's own panel.

name.label: Server name
name.help: Writes this name in the HUD corner for everyone. Empty = the server's name from its config. At most 48 characters.

logoUrl.label: Logo link
logoUrl.help: Shows a picture instead of the name for every player. The link must start with https or nui; empty brings the name back.

logoWidth.label: Logo width
logoWidth.help: Makes the logo wider or narrower. The unit grows with the screen, so it looks the same size for everyone.

logoHeight.label: Logo height
logoHeight.help: Sets the logo height. 0 = follow the picture's own proportions, usually the best choice.

x.label: Position from the left
x.help: Moves the name or logo sideways: 0 is the far left, 100 the far right. Dragging it in the w_hud panel is easier.

y.label: Position from the top
y.help: Moves the name or logo up or down: 0 is the top of the screen, 100 the bottom.

scale.label: Size
scale.help: Scales the whole name or logo.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.help: Makes the name or logo a little see-through.

food.label: Food and drink
food.help: Sets what every food, drink and medicine does to a player. A change applies from the next bite, for everyone, without a restart.

locked.pack: A pack: it gives 20 cigarettes and is not eaten
locked.ingredient: A cooking ingredient: used in recipes, not eaten
locked.unused: Not usable on this server yet

hunger.label: Hunger
hunger.help: Raises the player's hunger bar by this much when eaten (out of 100). A negative number makes them hungrier.

thirst.label: Thirst
thirst.help: Quenches thirst by this much (out of 100). A negative number makes them thirsty, like salty or dry food.

stamina.label: Stamina core
stamina.help: Fills the small circle inside the stamina icon. It makes the running bar come back faster after sprinting.

innerHealth.label: Health core
innerHealth.help: Fills the small circle inside the health icon, the one that heals over time. A negative number harms it, like smoking.

outerHealth.label: Instant health
outerHealth.help: Gives this much health right away. Full health is about 600; a negative number hurts.

outerStamina.label: Running bar
outerStamina.help: Refills this percent of the running bar itself (the ring that drains while you sprint). Normal food is 0; coffee and tonics have it.

goldHealth.label: Gold health
goldHealth.help: Turns health gold so it does not drop for the gilding time (see Gilding). Ring = the bar, core = the icon, both = everything.

goldStamina.label: Gold stamina
goldStamina.help: Same as gold health, for stamina: the player runs without tiring for the gilding time.

buffType.label: Buff
buffType.help: Gives an effect that lasts after eating and helps every pulse: recovery = health, healthy food = hunger and thirst, energy = stamina, vigor = health core, cowboy = horse stamina.

buffAmount.label: Buff strength
buffAmount.help: Sets how long the buff lasts: the bigger, the longer. Cannot be set while the buff is None.

fx.label: Drunk effect
fx.help: Makes the screen sway and blur as if the player were drunk. None = no effect.

fxTime.label: Drunk time
fxTime.help: How many minutes the drunk effect stays on screen. Does nothing while the effect is None.

poison.label: Poisons
poison.help: Poisons the player for this many seconds: the heart's ring dims, fumes rise from it and health drops bit by bit. 0 = no poison.

curesPoison.label: Cures poison
curesPoison.help: Removes poison at once when a poisoned player uses it, like the antidote.

heal.label: Heals wounds
heal.help: Stops bleeding and heals wounds (the medic script), like the strong medicines.

buffs.label: Buffs
buffs.help: A buff is an effect that stays after eating or medicine, gives a bonus every pulse (2 s), then ends. Here: each kind's strength and how fast it fades.

tick.label: Pulse length
tick.help: Sets how many ms pass between two pulses of every buff. Leave it unless you know why; a small number costs players performance.

amount.label: Recovery: health per pulse
amount.help: Gives this much health every pulse while the recovery buff runs. It comes from medicine; full health is about 600.

drain.label: Recovery: fade speed
drain.help: Takes this much off the recovery buff every pulse. Higher = it ends sooner.

amount.label: Healthy food: hunger and thirst per pulse
amount.help: Adds this much hunger and thirst every pulse while it runs. It comes from vegetables, fruit, herbs and water.
amount.example: 2 per pulse = 60 hunger and 60 thirst a minute

drain.label: Healthy food: fade speed
drain.help: Takes this much off the healthy-food buff every pulse. Higher = it ends sooner.

amount.label: Energy: stamina per pulse
amount.help: Fills the stamina core by this much every pulse. It comes from coffee, tonics and snake oil.

drain.label: Energy: fade speed
drain.help: Takes this much off the energy buff every pulse. Higher = it ends sooner.

amount.label: Vigor: health core per pulse
amount.help: Fills the health core by this much every pulse. It comes from cooked meat.

drain.label: Vigor: fade speed
drain.help: Takes this much off the vigor buff every pulse. Higher = it ends sooner.

amount.label: Cowboy: horse stamina
amount.help: Refills the stamina of the last horse ridden every pulse. No food gives it today unless you set it on an item in the food table.

drain.label: Cowboy: fade speed
drain.help: Takes this much off the cowboy buff every pulse. Higher = it ends sooner.

poison.label: Poison
poison.help: Poison is temporary: the heart's ring dims, fumes rise from it and health drops every hit until time runs out, an antidote is taken or the player dies. Each item's time is in the food table.

enabled.label: Poison is on
enabled.help: Off: poisonous food poisons nobody. The antidote still works as usual.

damage.label: Health lost per hit
damage.help: Takes this much health every poison hit. Full health is about 600.

minHealth.label: Lowest health from poison
minHealth.help: Poison stops at this health and does not kill. 0 = poison can kill.

staminaDrain.label: Stamina lost per hit
staminaDrain.help: Takes this much off the stamina core every hit, so a poisoned player cannot run much.

tick.label: Time between two hits
tick.help: Sets how many ms pass between two poison hits. Smaller = stronger poison.

fx.label: Screen effect
fx.help: Sets what the poisoned player sees on screen while poisoned.

gold.label: Gilding
gold.help: Some medicines and foods turn health or stamina gold so it does not drop. This is how long the gold lasts.

duration.label: Gilding time
duration.help: How many seconds health or stamina stays gold after eating or medicine. Applies to every item with gilding.

horse.label: Horse food
horse.help: When you give this food to your horse within 3 m, the horse eats it; with no horse near, the player eats it. A change applies from the next feed.

hunger.label: Horse hunger
hunger.help: Fills the horse's hunger by this much (out of 100).

stamina.label: Horse stamina
stamina.help: Refills the horse's stamina by this much (out of 100), so it runs longer.

health.label: Horse health
health.help: Restores the horse's health by this much (out of 100).

animals.label: Feeding animals
animals.help: Sets how players feed pets and wild animals: how close they must be, and how long between two feeds.

distance.label: Farthest feeding distance
distance.help: The player must be closer than this to the animal to feed it.

cooldown.label: Wait between feeds
cooldown.help: How many seconds must pass before the same animal can be fed again. 0 = no wait.

duration.label: Feeding time
duration.help: How many seconds the animal takes to eat. Walking away meanwhile cancels it.

satchels.label: Satchels
satchels.help: Each satchel adds carry weight on top of the base 30 kg. A bigger satchel replaces a smaller one; they do not stack.
satchels.confirm: This changes the carry weight of every player who already owns this satchel, not only future buyers.

bonus.label: Extra carry weight
bonus.help: How many kilograms this satchel adds to the base 30 kg.

systems.label: Systems
systems.help: Turns whole w_hud systems on or off. Some need a restart of w_hud to apply.

buffs.label: Buffs
buffs.help: Off: no buff runs; food still fills but leaves no lasting effect. Applies at once.

consumables.label: Using food and drink
consumables.help: Off: food and drink cannot be used from the bag. Applies after a restart of w_hud.

horseCare.label: Horse feeding
horseCare.help: Off: food cannot be given to horses. Applies after a restart of w_hud.

voice.help: Set your voice level: /voice <1-%s | up | down>

theme.dangerHint: Ring and icon at the danger line

theme.boostHealthHint: The health circle while a booster runs — yours and your horse's
theme.boostStaminaHint: The stamina circle while a booster runs — yours and your horse's
theme.talkHint: The voice circle's disc while you speak
theme.moneyHint: Every wallet row without a colour of its own
theme.moneyRowHint: The row's figure and icon — unset, it follows the wallet, then the money colour

settings.title: HUD Settings
settings.sub: Drag anything on screen to place it where you want
settings.adminOnly: This section is for admins -- everything in it applies to every player.
settings.srvLogoNote: A link here replaces the name with the logo, for every player.
settings.srvNeeds: How fast hunger and thirst fall
settings.srvHungerAt: Damage starts when hunger falls to
settings.srvThirstAt: Damage starts when thirst falls to
settings.srvCanKillOff: No killing: health falls, then stops short of death
settings.srvFeaturesNote: Anything switched off here disappears for every player, and they cannot bring it back.
settings.srvLiveNote: Everything here shows on your screen at once, and reaches the other players a moment after you stop adjusting.
settings.srvIdDrag: Drag the name or logo on screen to move it -- its place reaches every player.
settings.nothing: Pick one above, or click it on screen
settings.below: Show once the value falls to
settings.dangerWins: Danger colour over poison and boosters
settings.statesOrderDanger: When a circle is in two states at once: danger first, then poison, then booster, then warning.
settings.statesOrderEffect: When a circle is in two states at once: poison first, then booster, then danger, then warning.
settings.walletOrder: A row's colour beats the Wallet's own colour (Elements), which beats the money colour, which beats the default.
settings.shapeNote: One shape for every circle -- what tells them apart is colour and meaning, not ring weight.
settings.tips: Arrows nudge the selected element · Shift + arrows moves faster · Shift while dragging ignores snapping
settings.shareIn: Paste a code to apply it
settings.imageHint: Any format: PNG · JPG · animated GIF · WebP · APNG · SVG · MP4 · WebM -- the link is all it needs
settings.imageBad: The link must start with https://, http:// or nui://
settings.logoNote: A link here replaces the server name with the picture.
